gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Holds only this mod's sequence assembly patterns (one per slot). Unit patterns and refinedstorage:pattern are rejected; generating/importing consumes nothing.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 只放本模组的序列装配总样板（一格一张）：单元样板与 refinedstorage:pattern 都放不进去；生成样板 / 导入配方不再消耗材料。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Scroll = list; Ctrl+LMB = step config; LMB machine area = pick machine; Shift+LMB/RMB = move up/down; RMB = delete step
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 滚轮 = 滚动列表；Ctrl+左键 = 详细配置；左键机器区 = 选机器；Shift+左键/右键 = 上移/下移；右键 = 删除该步

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Unit pattern library: drag patterns into the flow list; click the title to open the chamber unit summary
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 单元样板库：存放单元样板，可拖到流程编排行；左键标题打开「执行仓单元样板汇总」

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Generate the assembly pattern into the slot at the bottom-right, then take it out (no material consumed; move the old pattern away first)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 生成装配样板：写入界面右下角的「生成槽」，取走即可（不再消耗材料；槽里有样板时需先取走）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Open the recipe list and transfer a Create sequenced-assembly recipe into the flow (no material consumed)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 打开配方选择界面：把一张 Create 序列装配配方一键转移进流程（不再消耗材料）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.en: Cannot generate: the flow and the outputs are both empty.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_pattern_te.zh: 无法生成装配样板：流程与产物都为空

gui.rs_create_compat.step_detail.recipe_.en: Recipe type of this step (the raw id is shown in the grey line below)
gui.rs_create_compat.step_detail.recipe_.zh: 本步的配方类型（原始 id 见下方灰字）
